main_measure.name: OLS slope of 5-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 grid cases

decided_by: Confirmed on every fold, but the main measure points the other way on the check folds (A, D), the years step 7 does not explore: main measure -0.0001029 on the check folds against +0.0003417 on every fold.
reading: All grid bars count as cases, flat forecasts included. Positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window are used where a 5-bar-ahead close exists. The drift is each coin's mean grid return over all its windows. The t is the ordinary OLS slope t, and fewer than 300 cases is reported as not observable.
